                  Add the information in brackets to the sentences and rewrite them in an appropriate way, using
                  the examples in A and B as models.

                    part of the Maddison Enterprises Group)

                      new. generation of high-speed  trains...

                    German  measles)
                  4 Four kilos of Beluga caviar has been ordered for the reception. (Beluga caviar is among the most
                    expensive foods in the world)
                 5  One of the most popular modern writers for children is John Marsden. (John Marsden is Australian)

                    the last ten years)

                    Downlands Hospital)
